data.name: Kati
data.gender_notes: Kati is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Katerina, meaning 'pure'. In the New Testament, Saint Catherine is the patron saint of scholars, students, and unmarried women. The name Kati carries the meaning “Pure” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kati usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kati belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kati total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: קאטי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם קאטי הוא שׁם נגזר מן השׁורש היווני 'קאטא', שׁמובנו טהרה וקפדנות. הוא משׁויך לנושאים של טהרה רוחנית וקפדנות מוסרית, ומהווה השראה לשׂמיחׂ וחדווה בקרב הנוצרים.

in_greek.name: Κατι
in_greek.long_meaning: Τὸ ὄνομα Κατι προέρχεται ἀπὸ τὴν ἰδεα τῆς καθαρότητας καὶ ἀρετῆς. Εἰς τὴν Ἐκκλησίαν, ὁ ὄνομα αὐτὸς συμβολίζει τὴν πνευματικὴν καθαρότητα καὶ τὴν ὁσίτητος, δι' ὅλου τοῦ Χριστιανικοῦ κόσμου.

in_latin.name: Kati
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Kati originem ducit a notionibus puritatis et sanctitatis. In Ecclesia, hoc nomen significat purificationem spiritualem et sanctimoniam, quae sunt virtutes christianae.

in_english.name: Kati
in_english.meaning: Pure and holy, a symbol of spiritual cleanliness
in_english.long_meaning: The name Kati is derived from Greek and Hebrew roots, signifying purity and holiness. It symbolizes spiritual cleanliness and moral integrity, highly valued in Christian traditions. Historically, names with similar roots have been associated with virtues of sanctity and righteousness.
